summary: The zero-self Frobenius half-Riesz estimate cannot be extended with the same cross-Frobenius scaling to arbitrary active self blocks. For iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] and S_eta=(2eta)^(-1)[[1+eta,1-eta],[1-eta,1+eta]], s_2(S_eta)=1 and b_eta=(1-eta)/(2eta), but H_{1/2}(X^T S_eta X;0)*sqrt(b_eta)~log(4/eta)->infinity. Applying the completed account03/B03 rank-one physical-cross collision theorem gives E|R_eta-R_eta'|^(-1/2)<=8/sqrt(b_eta), so the one-copy endpoint exceeds the actual dependence-safe collision potential by an unbounded logarithmic factor. This refutes collision-to-one-copy endpoint promotion and arbitrary-self cross-Frobenius scaling, not the full QFORM conjecture. A corrected sufficient condition is |det P|>=delta b^2 for a physical pair P=[[a,b],[b,c]], which via the completed rank-two affine half-Riesz theorem gives H_{1/2}<=128 delta^(-1/4)|b|^(-1/2).
